concept_text: A global consulting firm is using Amazon Q Business to build an internal AI assistant that allows employees to search company policies and project documents by using natural language prompts. concept_text: A global logistics analytics platform is developing an intelligent freight-routing assistant that generates optimized route summaries across multiple regions. concept_text: A global e-commerce enterprise is preparing a major product launch and requires a large-scale system for continuous monitoring of customer feedback across multiple social media platforms. The analytics group must perform sentiment scoring across all retrieved content and must generate long-term trend visualizations for leadership teams that track sentiment changes across product categories, geographic regions, and marketing campaigns. Enable CloudWatch alarms to alert analysts based on configured sentiment thresholds automatically.
